newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cement producer Huwei to list A shares.
newsitem.headline: Cement producer Huwei to list A shares.

text.p: Cement producer Guangxi Huwei Co Ltd said on Monday the Shenzhen bourse had approved its listing of 15.50 million class A shares and 4.50 million staff shares in Shenzhen on September 19.

The A shares were issued at 4.10 yuan per share earlier this month, while the staff shares were offered at one yuan per share in 1993, Huwei said in a listing notice carried in the official Securities Times.
Guangxi Trust and Investment Co and China Economic Development Trust and Investment Co have been appointed Huwei's listing promoters, it said.
Huwei said it had a total share capital of 60.55 million shares, including 28.80 million state shares, 7.24 million legal person shares, 15.50 million class A shares and 9.01 million employee shares.
Huwei said it would use the proceeds from the A share issue to upgrade production equipment and technology.

Huwei, based in the city of Beiliu in southwestern Guangxi province, has forecast net earnings of 16.16 million yuan for 1996, compared with 7.14 million yuan posted last year and 13.91 million yuan in 1994.
The firm did not explain the profit decline in 1995.
